lockedDecisions: Keep the lowercase “aoi” text wordmark; do not invent a replacement logo.
Preserve the exact midnight landing colors #120D13, #F6EDF3, #C5B2C2, and #5C4255.
Preserve the existing serif-display and sans-body typography roles.
Use product and privacy claims only when verified; no invented customers, testimonials, prices, guarantees, or results.
assumptions: The marketing page may use verified light app colors for the light compositions shown in the selected references, while retaining the established midnight identity.

creativeDirection.summary: An intimate editorial identity: generous type and human imagery set against quiet light surfaces, with AOI’s midnight atmosphere used as a memorable anchor.

traits.boundary: not a magazine imitation with excess labels or ornamental rules
not sparse enough to hide how the product works
not a full-page blur or decorative gradient system

creativeDirection.productiveTension: A quiet, private midnight mood alongside open, readable editorial space.

signatureDevice.description: A still, rain-softened night photograph behind a dark scrim, paired with a large serif statement and ample negative space, derived from AOI’s existing landing treatment.
invariants: Use the verified rain-window image only where its atmosphere supports the message.
Keep the photograph still and the text legible over an opaque-enough scrim.
Use the device as a focal treatment, not as a repeated background behind ordinary content.

creativeDirection.restraint: Let scale, crop, and spacing carry the identity; reserve atmospheric photography and accent color for moments with a clear purpose.
avoid: Invented client logos, ratings, quotes, or portraits presented as customers.
Hand-drawn SVG decoration or a new logo.
A card around every paragraph.
Repeated hairline grids where the chosen reference has open space.
Unrelated coral, cyan, and green accents competing with AOI’s rose palette.

interfaceDirection: Use a broad desktop content width around 1200–1360px and 24–48px side margins, reducing to roughly 20–24px on mobile. Give headlines generous line breaks and keep body measures near 55–70 characters. Use a 4/8px spacing basis with visibly larger 32–96px gaps between distinct content groups. Preserve the references’ contrast between open light editorial surfaces and contained dark focal surfaces without forcing a divider between every group. Use mostly flat surfaces, restrained borders where controls or disclosures need definition, and little or no shadow. Photographic or product-media units may have modest 16–28px corners; ordinary prose stays unboxed. Controls remain familiar: clear labels, at least 44px targets, visible focus rings, distinct hover, pressed, disabled, and expanded states. Use the project’s established icons or a professional icon set, with no decorative custom SVG system. The rose accent must appear in the primary action, focus and selected states, and one recurring media or content treatment, with contrast checked on both themes.

imageDirection.summary: Pair meaningful product views and intimate, candid moments with AOI’s existing rain-window atmosphere. Preserve the references’ large image frames, deliberate crops, and human scale while changing their subjects to Aoi.
subjects: Two people sharing an ordinary moment, without posing as customers.
Hands, keepsakes, places, or small details that plausibly become shared memories.
Truthful captures of the current Aoi interface, where available.
Original illustrative moment content clearly presented as examples.
imageDirection.treatment: Use natural light and restrained color on light surfaces; use the verified night image with a scrim for dark atmosphere. Favor substantial image areas and content-shaped crops over floating mockups or ornamental diagrams. Keep faces and key details visible on mobile crops.
avoid: Fake testimonials or named users.
Images implying generated people are real Aoi customers.
Unverified interface screens presented as shipping features.
Generic abstract SVG filler.
Heavy blur that obscures the subject.

motionDirection.summary: Visible but contained motion should explain how text and imagery come together without changing the reference layouts.
principles: Introduce the hero on load; stagger the headline, supporting copy, action, and existing media frame in place using opacity and a small translation; 500–750ms with a gentle ease-out and at most 240ms total stagger; show the final state immediately for reduced motion.

Reveal later editorial groups once as they approach the viewport; bring the heading and adjacent image into their fixed layout using opacity and short, directionally related translations; 450–700ms with a soft ease-out; keep all content visible when scripting fails or reduced motion is active.

Reveal a later media-led group once as it approaches the viewport; disclose the photograph inside its existing frame while nearby copy settles into place, without changing frame size; 500–800ms with a smooth ease-out; show the complete frame immediately for reduced motion.

Confirm button, navigation, and disclosure input on hover, focus, press, or expansion; change color, border, and small positional emphasis without hiding information; 120–220ms with a direct ease-out; preserve equivalent visible states for reduced motion.
avoid: transition: all
Scale-from-zero entrances
Hover-only information
Scroll-jacking or perpetual floating
Layout shifts
Reveal replay after scrolling, resize, or rerender
Hidden content on restored scroll positions
Animations that block interaction

voice.summary: Warm, direct, and specific. Speak to two people building a shared history through small actions they can recognize; prefer plain verbs such as save, share, plan, and revisit.
avoid: Claims of measured impact or customer love without evidence.
Overwritten romance and vague promises of connection.
Unverified security, pricing, or availability claims.
Product mechanics described as internal implementation.
